doors.why: V2: Cinder Hollow Recovery Bay (cyan cross)

t: CINDER HOLLOW. Raised on the first ember seam of Pyros.
Below, someone has scratched: 'Dig deep, come home.'
The camp furnace. It has not gone out in forty years.
A brass plate reads: 'Lit by Old Basalt.'
SHAFT 4 - CLOSED. Ember rain. Do not enter.
Volcano Tower: follow the ridge east.
Miner: Cinder Hollow sits on the richest ember seam on Pyros. Also the hottest. Mostly the hottest.
Smith: Magma-types temper their own hides in the vents.
Bring a Hydro-type if you plan to argue with one.
Cook: Nothing beats lava-baked rockroot. Crunchy outside, molten inside. Don't bite too fast.
Ash walker: The crater's light still flickers some nights. The old-timers won't look at it.
Old miner: Basalt saw the first pod land, you know. He's been Keeper longer than I've been alive.
Still climbs that tower every morning on those knees.
Traveler: The dome with the cyan cross is the Recovery Bay. Free healing, even for outworlders.
Camp watch: Helix suits came through asking about the deep shafts. We told 'em nothing.
Folks who ask about the deep shafts never want ore.
Kid: I'm gonna catch a Cindermole and ride it down the rail line!
Kid: ...Mom says no.
Nurse: Welcome to the Recovery Bay. We'll have your team patched up and cooled down in no time.
Miner: Took a cave-in on B2. My Bouldron caught the worst of it, bless him.
Clerk: Stasis Pods, burn salve, cooling tonics. Everything a Linker needs down the mines.
Smith: Heat-proof Stasis Pods? No such thing, kid. They all hold up fine down there.
Rail hand: Stay off the tracks when a cart's coming. The carts don't stop, and neither does the lava.
Ash walker: Wild Alienmon nest in the ember-weed. Stick to the dirt if you want a quiet walk.
Rail smith: The Deep Mines start past the east bend. Three levels down, and hotter every level.
Hiker: Trainers out here spot you from five paces. Eyes front, Pods ready.
Miner: Teo Reyes came down this shaft once, chasing some signal. Folks say his tracks go deeper than ours.
Geologist: These red crystals hum on the same pulse as the crater.
Signal Shards grow from the same rock, I'd bet my lamp on it.
Deep crew: Furnace Ridge is just above. No Recovery Bay down here, so heal up before you push on.
Forge keeper: Every forge on this ridge was lit from the volcano's heart. Old Basalt lit half of 'em.
Pilgrim: The Volcano Tower is just east. Keeper Basalt waits at the top. He doesn't go easy on anyone.
Helix grunt: Nothing to see here. Just... surveying the ridge. Move along, Linker.
Tower guard: Basalt's apprentices hold this floor. Beat them and the stairs are yours.

notes: Pyros 082-092. Ember-weed (red speckled patches) on routes 085/086/090 is ',' grass; caves use plain floor. Generosity calls: 086 ore cart on the only bridge (13,4) left walkable so the route connects; 090 left gate opened at (1,6),(1,7) through the gate post/rock so the left exit reaches the ember field (the art shows no other link); 092 lower wings reached through the thin pillar rail at (6,17)/(9,17); 091 side rooms entered at (6,15)/(9,15). 083 nurse pinned behind the counter at (8,5), bay counter (8,7); 084 clerk at (4,7) behind the L-counter, shop counter (4,8). Keeper Old Basalt at (7,3) on 092, challenged from (7,4). Apprentices on 091 at (6,4) facing right and (9,10) facing left.
